chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 (1920x1080).
Subject: two neutron stars at the moment they merge, small and intensely bright, with thin lilac ripples of gravitational waves spreading outward (an illustration, not a photograph).
Composition: the merger sits in the lower-left third; a large area of empty indigo night above and to the right; a single small gold ring floating faintly at the far right.
Lighting and treatment: hot lemon-white core (#F5D76E), indigo night (#0B0F2A), faint lilac wavefronts, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain.
Mood: wonder.
Text: "2 stars. 1 ring." in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), placed upper right.
Scientific accuracy: neutron star mergers are thought to make some heavy elements such as gold; how much of the gold comes from them is still debated, so show no certainty.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo.
Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
